guitar.guitaristsText: Mick Ronson / Carlos Alomar / Earl Slick
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Ronson) / Fender Stratocaster / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Bowie used many different guitarists across eras with no single signature instrument tied to Bowie himself; medium is appropriate given Ronson's well-known Les Paul.

tone.target: bright funky clean-crunch with slapback edge
tone.profile: bright funky clean-crunch with slapback edge
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing compression and a light boost into the US Deluxe/Silver Twin platform, shaped by a funk-focused EQ, finished with Slapback delay for rhythmic punch.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythmic definition.
Provide slight compression and enhance the rhythmic attack for funk feel.
Introduce a clean-to-crunch bite without heavy distortion, suitable for funk rhythm.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to maintain the bright, vintage single-coil character and avoid excessive grit.

blocks.purpose: Kept inactive to maintain a consistent funk tone and avoid unnecessary filtering.
blocks.gap: The target tone does not require wah effects.

blocks.purpose: No dedicated distortion needed; the Green OD provides sufficient bite.
blocks.gap: The required crunch is best achieved via a low-gain preamp model (Green OD).

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean Fender/Ampeg-style tone required for 70s funk.

alternatives.reason: Similar character, but US Deluxe is often preferred for its punchier clean headroom.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused sound suitable for funk and single-coil guitars.
Scoop the low end and boost mids/highs to emphasize the funky bite and clarity.
Add a subtle, rhythmic echo that enhances the 'slapback edge' and percussive feel.
Provide a subtle sense of space without muddying the tight funk tone.
blocks.gap: The target avoids deep reverb, so settings are kept low to maintain dryness.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better definition in funky clean-crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and clarity needed for funk rhythm.
